name: ludlow: break-glass read of a patient record
note: The risky op. Emergency privileged access to decades-confidential HIPAA patient data. Single-state triple (min,mode,max): the £ EXPOSURE of doing this op wrongly / from the wrong hands. carried ~= £2.4M -> top assurance band: a fresh attested device + step-up passkey, nothing less. A stale device can't even be caged to read-only here (a read-only peek at patient data is still the breach).
